canonical_example.text: ¿Podrías devolver estos libros a la bibliotecaria?
canonical_example.translation: Could you give these books back to the librarian?

canonical_example.text: Como no le gustaron los zapatos, los devolvió.
canonical_example.translation: As he didn't like the shoes, he returned them.

canonical_example.text: ¿Has devuelto la película al videoclub?
canonical_example.translation: Have you taken the movie back to the video store?

canonical_example.text: Si el vendedor no le devuelve el dinero, puede presentar una demanda.
canonical_example.translation: If the vendor does not refund your money, you can file a complaint.

canonical_example.text: En cuanto pueda, le devuelvo el favor.
canonical_example.translation: As soon as I can, I will return the favor.

canonical_example.text: Devuelva lo que tomó.
canonical_example.translation: Give back what you took.

canonical_example.text: Devuelva las llaves cuando pague.
canonical_example.translation: Return the keys when you pay.

canonical_example.text: Devolvieron al prisionero a la cárcel tras haberse escapado.
canonical_example.translation: The prisoner was sent back to prison after having escaped.

canonical_example.text: Me tienen que devolver dos dólares porque pagué diez y valía ocho.
canonical_example.translation: They have to give me back two dollars because I paid ten, and it cost eight.

canonical_example.text: Devolvieron el cheque porque no había suficientes fondos.
canonical_example.translation: They returned the check because there were insufficient funds.

canonical_example.text: Miles tiene gripa; por eso está devolviendo todo lo que come.
canonical_example.translation: Miles has got the flu; that's why he's throwing up everything he eats.

canonical_example.text: El perro estaba enfermo y devolvió la comida que había comido.
canonical_example.translation: The dog was sick and brought up the food he'd eaten.

canonical_example.text: Creo que voy a devolver.
canonical_example.translation: I think I'm going to be sick.

canonical_example.text: Se devolvió por el mismo camino.
canonical_example.translation: She turned back along the same road.

canonical_example.text: Los puercos son más inteligentes de lo que muchos creen.
canonical_example.translation: Pigs are smarter than many people think.

canonical_example.text: Mis vecinos tienen un puerco que pesa 200 kilos.
canonical_example.translation: My neighbors have a hog that weighs 200 kilos.

canonical_example.text: Mi compañera de cuarto es una puerca. ¡Solo se baña una vez a la semana!
canonical_example.translation: My roommate is a pig. She only showers once a week!

canonical_example.text: Les encantaron las tostadas de puerco deshebrado.
canonical_example.translation: They loved the shredded pork tostadas.

canonical_example.text: Me da asco la casa de María porque está tan puerca.
canonical_example.translation: Maria's house makes me feel sick because it's so dirty.

canonical_example.text: ¡Ya basta con tus chistes puercos!
canonical_example.translation: Enough already with your nasty jokes!

canonical_example.text: La puerca acaba de parir. - Ya sé; ¡los cerditos están hermosos!
canonical_example.translation: The sow just gave birth. - I know; the piglets are so cute!

canonical_example.text: ¡Quita las manos de mi hermana, puerco!
canonical_example.translation: Get your hands off my sister, you pig!

canonical_example.text: Ricardo es un puerco que no sabe hablar bien de las mujeres.
canonical_example.translation: Ricardo is a swine who doesn't know how to talk respectfully about women.

canonical_example.text: No voy a comer en este puerco restaurante.
canonical_example.translation: I'm not going to eat in this filthy restaurant.

canonical_example.text: Esa película es puerca; no es apta para menores.
canonical_example.translation: That's a disgusting movie; it's not suitable for minors.

canonical_example.text: Yo acabo mis clases en junio.
canonical_example.translation: I finish my classes in June.

canonical_example.text: Te llamaré después de que acabe la película.
canonical_example.translation: I'll call you after the movie ends.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quién acabó la leche?
canonical_example.translation: Who finished the milk?

canonical_example.text: Deberíamos acabar estas sobras en vez de cocinar hoy.
canonical_example.translation: We should use up these leftovers rather than cook today.

canonical_example.text: Ya descansaremos cuando acabe el proyecto.
canonical_example.translation: We can rest when the project is over.

canonical_example.text: Acabaremos cuando acabemos.
canonical_example.translation: We'll be done when we're done.

canonical_example.text: Si tienes problemas para acabar, deberías consultar el médico.
canonical_example.translation: If you have problems coming, you should see a doctor.

canonical_example.text: Se le acabaron las barras de pan a la panadería.
canonical_example.translation: The bakery's run out of baguettes.

canonical_example.text: Voy a acabarme el café y luego nos vamos.
canonical_example.translation: I'm going to finish my coffee and then we can go.

canonical_example.text: Siguieron bailando aun después de que se acabara la música.
canonical_example.translation: They kept dancing even after the music ended.

canonical_example.text: La película se acabó temprano.
canonical_example.translation: The movie finished early.

canonical_example.text: Cuando se acabe todo esto, tendremos que darnos algún capricho.
canonical_example.translation: When all this is over, we'll have to treat ourselves to something.

canonical_example.text: Será un alivio cuando se acaben las obras.
canonical_example.translation: It will be a relief when the building work is done.

canonical_example.text: Se acabó tres días después de haber sido herido en el campo de batalla.
canonical_example.translation: He died three days after being wounded on the battlefield.

canonical_example.text: Hay cientos de vuelos cancelados a causa de la tormenta.
canonical_example.translation: There are hundreds of canceled flights due to the storm.

canonical_example.translation: The number on the invoice corresponds to a closed bank account.

canonical_example.translation: I've paid the $1,000 I owed, so my debt is settled.

canonical_example.translation: I wish I could erase from my mind the terrible image of her falling into the void.

canonical_example.translation: The Human Resources director has fired three employees in a month.

canonical_example.translation: That hat is too big for you. It hides your entire face!

canonical_example.text: Ella se comió el pastel entero.
canonical_example.translation: She ate the whole cake.

canonical_example.translation: Rust eats away metal.

canonical_example.text: El sol se comió la pintura del carro.
canonical_example.translation: The sun faded the paint on the car.

canonical_example.text: La lluvia ácida se come las estatuas de bronce.
canonical_example.translation: Acid rain corrodes bronze statues.

canonical_example.text: ¡Los impuestos se me comen la mayor parte de mi sueldo!
canonical_example.translation: Much of my pay is eaten up by taxes!

canonical_example.translation: Ivan blew through his lottery winnings in a few months.

canonical_example.translation: They put an ointment on his nails so that he wouldn't bite them.

canonical_example.text: Te comiste toda la puntuación.
canonical_example.translation: You missed all the punctuation.

canonical_example.text: Se comió las palabras cuando estaba hablando con su enamorada.
canonical_example.translation: He swallowed his words when he was talking to his crush.

canonical_example.text: Se comió el techo con la cabeza.
canonical_example.translation: He hit his head against the ceiling.

canonical_example.text: Nos comimos la puerta del garaje cuando dimos marcha atrás.
canonical_example.translation: We crashed into the garage door when we reversed.

canonical_example.translation: I found a rotten orange that had fallen behind the refrigerator.

canonical_example.translation: The municipal system for issuing building permits is completely rotten.

canonical_example.translation: The dampness rotted away the wood in the doorframe.

canonical_example.text: No puedo creer que de verdad la gente haya votado por ese político podrido otra vez.
canonical_example.translation: I can't believe people actually voted for that corrupt politician again.

canonical_example.text: Me tiene podrido porque siempre está con la misma queja.
canonical_example.translation: I am fed-up with her because she is always complaining about the same thing.

canonical_example.text: Estoy podrido de sus retos tontos.
canonical_example.translation: I am tired of his silly insults.

canonical_example.text: Si dejas la carne afuera de la nevera, el calor la pudrirá.
canonical_example.translation: If you leave the meat outside the fridge, the heat will decay it.

canonical_example.text: Me pudre que se aprovechen de tu buen corazón.
canonical_example.translation: It upsets me when they take advantage of your good heart.

canonical_example.text: Sus continuas quejas terminaron pudriendo a su esposa.
canonical_example.translation: His wife finally became fed up with his endless complaints.

canonical_example.translation: These soap operas bore me to death. They're the most boring ones there are.

canonical_example.text: Todas las fresas que compramos se están pudriendo.
canonical_example.translation: All the strawberries we bought are rotting.

canonical_example.text: Si no te comes los bananos pronto, se van a pudrir.
canonical_example.translation: If you don't eat the bananas soon, they are going to go bad.

canonical_example.text: Cuando encontraron el cadáver, ya estaba pudriéndose.
canonical_example.translation: When they found the corpse, it was already decaying.

canonical_example.translation: The poison causes the rat's corpse to dry without decomposing.

canonical_example.text: Deben dejar que se pudra en la cárcel por cometer un crimen tan horrendo.
canonical_example.translation: They should let him rot in jail for committing such a horrendous crime.

canonical_example.text: La pobre anciana se pudrió sola en ese caserón.
canonical_example.translation: The poor old lady languished alone in that big house.

canonical_example.text: Si vienes conmigo a esa reunión, vas a pudrirte.
canonical_example.translation: If you come with me to that meeting, you are going to die of boredom.

canonical_example.translation: I don't want to see you again. Go to hell!

canonical_example.text: ¡Y luego me enseñó su nuevo celular tan chulo!

canonical_example.text: ¿Viste la novia chula de Ethan?
canonical_example.translation: Did you see Ethan's cute girlfriend?
